patterns.note: Content is primarily centered within full-width sections, with a two-column layout introduced for feature sections where text is aligned right and abstract graphics are on the left.
Headings use a very large, bold sans-serif for high impact, contrasting with smaller, well-spaced sans-serif body text and uppercase navigation links.
A high-contrast palette of deep charcoal/black and off-white/light gray is consistently used for backgrounds and text, punctuated by a vibrant orange accent for branding elements and calls to action.

A large, curved shape transitions the dark hero section into the light content section as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic reveal. The navigation bar also adapts its background and text color to maintain contrast against the changing section backgrounds while remaining sticky.
Sections are clearly delineated by full-bleed background color changes (dark to light gray) and distinct content layouts, creating a strong visual rhythm down the page.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations (likely using GSAP) to create a dynamic experience. This includes a large, curved mask or shape that transitions between full-bleed background colors as the user scrolls, revealing new content. A sticky navigation bar dynamically changes its background and text color to ensure legibility against the varying section backgrounds. Content within sections appears to slide or fade into view as the user scrolls them into the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, well-spaced body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle for interactive elements like buttons, sharp for overall section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around content elements.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the large, curved shape transition that dynamically reveals the next section as the user scrolls, creating a fluid and engaging visual flow between high-contrast background colors. This, combined with the minimal aesthetic and abstract line art, gives the site a sophisticated and modern feel.
